description: Extracts comments from Instagram posts using apidojo's Instagram Comments Scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get all comments on an Instagram post, scrape Instagram comment data, export comments from an Instagram URL, fetch comment text and engagement from Instagram posts, collect commenter usernames from a post, or download audience reaction data from Instagram content. Returns comment text, like count, reply count, commenter username, verified status, and timestamp. Ideal for sentiment analysts, community managers, and social media researchers.
